market.question: Will the minimum Arctic sea ice extent this summer be less than 4m square kilometers?

assessment.reasoning: 2025 Arctic minimum was 4.60M sq km (10th lowest). Only 2007, 2012, 2016, 2019, 2020 have been below 4M in satellite record - roughly 5 of 47 years (~11%). Recent decade averages ~4.3-4.5. Probability ~20-30% based on climatology.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Winter ice extent and summer atmospheric patterns largely determine outcome
